<div class="row-fluid-wrapper row-depth-1 row-number-1 header_area-row-0-padding dnd-section header_area-row-0-background-color header_area-row-0-background-layers header_area-row-0-max-width-section-centering">

<div class="row-fluid ">
<div class="span12 widget-span widget-type-custom_widget dnd-module" style="" data-widget-type="custom_widget" data-x="0" data-w="12">
<div id="hs_cos_wrapper_dnd_area-module-2" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module widget-type-rich_text widget-type-rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module"><span id="hs_cos_wrapper_dnd_area-module-2_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="rich_text"><h1 style="color: #ffffff; text-align: center;"><span style="color: #00335e;">Travel Guide</span></h1>
<p style="color: #ffffff; font-size: 18px; text-align: center;"><span style="color: #00335e;">We know traveling can be a hassle. With over 51% of our patients coming from out-of-state or internationally, we understand the challenges involved. That's why we've compiled essential tips and resources to ensure your visit is as comfortable and stress-free as possible. To learn more about what to expect as a TIP patient, connect with one of our volunteer families!</span></p>

We have partnered with a range of hotels, recommend several allergy-friendly restaurants, and suggest nearby activities to simplify your stay. Our goal is to ensure you can focus on what truly matters: overcoming food allergies with your family.</p></span></div>

<div class="row-fluid-wrapper row-depth-1 row-number-8 dnd-row">
<div class="row-fluid ">
<div class="span12 widget-span widget-type-custom_widget dnd-module module_1711405520228-hidden" style="" data-widget-type="custom_widget" data-x="0" data-w="12">
<div id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1711405520228" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_module widget-type-rich_text widget-type-rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="module"><span id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1711405520228_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_rich_text" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="rich_text"><h5 data-block-type="core">General Tips:</h5>
<ul>
<li data-block-type="core">Book a hotel with a kitchen</li>
<li data-block-type="core">Wipe down airplane seats and trays</li>
<li data-block-type="core">Bring safe snacks for longer flights</li>
<li data-block-type="core">Communicate allergies clearly with airline, hotel, and restaurant staff</li>
<li data-block-type="core">Always carry two epinephrine auto-injectors!</li>
<li data-block-type="core">Make travel fun by exploring new attractions each visit</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-block-type="core">Airline Savings:</h5>
<ul>
<li data-block-type="core"><a href="https://www.southwest.com/rapid-rewards/tiers/companion-pass/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Southwest Companion Pass: </a>Offered by Southwest Airlines, the Companion Pass allows qualifying members <span>to choose one person to fly with them, free of airline charges&nbsp;</span><span style="font-weight: normal;">(excluding taxes and fees).</span><a href="https://www.southwest.com/rapid-rewards/tiers/companion-pass/" rel="noopener" target="_blank" style="text-decoration: underline;"><span></span></a></li>
<li data-block-type="core"><strong>Travel Credit Cards:</strong> Take advantage of travel credit cards to book flights and hotels with points. Booked with points and regularly rebooked flights if prices dropped to save even more points.</li>
<li data-block-type="core"><strong>Quick Turnaround Trips:</strong> Quick trips can help families save on rental cars and hotel stays.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p></span></div>

</div><!--end widget-span -->
</div><!--end row-->
</div><!--end row-wrapper -->

<li>Encourages passengers to bring their own food.</li>

<li data-start="817" data-end="902">Offers <em data-start="824" data-end="848">nut-free snack options</em> and will create a buffer zone if notified in advance.</li>
<li data-start="905" data-end="978">Allows travelers to bring their own safe food and request early boarding.</li>

<p>Located at 4100 Donald Douglas Dr., Long Beach, CA 90808, the Long Beach Airport offers flights to and from multiple US states. This airport is smaller and typically less crowded than other LA-area airports. In addition, major car rental companies operate on-site, and shuttles are available for off-site rentals.<br><br>Long Beach Airport (LGB) is conveniently located approximately 2 miles from our Willow Clinic, with a travel time of about 10 minutes depending on traffic. This airport is also about 75 miles from our Vista Clinic, with a drive time of around 1.5 hours, depending on traffic conditions.<br><br>For more information about the Long Beach Airport (LGB), please visit their website at <a href="http://www.longbeach.gov/lgb/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">www.longbeach.gov/lgb/</a> or call them directly at (562) 570-7387.</p>

<p>Located at 1 World Way, Los Angeles, CA 90045, the Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) offers flights to a vast array of domestic destinations across the United States, as well as international flights to Asia, Europe, South America, and beyond.</p>
<p>As one of the busiest airports in the world, LAX provides a comprehensive array of services and amenities to accommodate millions of travelers each year. LAX has 9 different terminals, organized well and connected to each other by shuttles. In addition, all major car rental companies operate on-site, with shuttle services to off-site locations, and there are several ground transportation services available.&nbsp;<br><br>Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) is approximately 25 miles from our Willow Clinic, with a drive time of about 30 to 45 minutes depending on traffic. It is approximately 90 miles from our Vista Clinic, with a drive time of around 1.5 to 2 hours, depending on traffic conditions.<br><br>For more information about the Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), please visit their website at <a href="http://flylax.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">flylax.com</a> or call them directly at (855) 463-5252.</p>

In addition, various transportation options including taxis, ride-sharing services, shuttle buses, and public transportation are available.<br><br>John Wayne Airport (SNA) is approximately 20 miles from our Willow Clinic, with a drive time of about 30 to 35 minutes depending on traffic conditions. Our Vista Clinic is about 55 miles, with a drive time between 1 to 1.5 hours depending on traffic.<br><br>For more information about the John Wayne Airport (SNA), please visit their website at <a href="http://ocair.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">ocair.com</a> or call them directly at (949) 252-5200.</p>

<div class="accordion__header-text">
<h5 class="accordion-title mb-0">
Activities Near the Long Beach Clinic
</h5>
</div>
<figure class="accordion__icon accordion__close-icon">
<span id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1721421774072_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_icon" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="icon"><svg version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewbox="0 0 448 512" aria-hidden="true"><g id="chevron-down45_layer"><path d="M207.029 381.476L12.686 187.132c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941l22.667-22.667c9.357-9.357 24.522-9.375 33.901-.04L224 284.505l154.745-154.021c9.379-9.335 24.544-9.317 33.901.04l22.667 22.667c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941L240.971 381.476c-9.373 9.372-24.569 9.372-33.942 0z" /></g></svg></span>

<span id="hs_cos_wrapper_module_1721421774072_" class="hs_cos_wrapper hs_cos_wrapper_widget hs_cos_wrapper_type_icon" style="" data-hs-cos-general-type="widget" data-hs-cos-type="icon"><svg version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewbox="0 0 448 512" aria-hidden="true"><g id="chevron-up46_layer"><path d="M240.971 130.524l194.343 194.343c9.373 9.373 9.373 24.569 0 33.941l-22.667 22.667c-9.357 9.357-24.522 9.375-33.901.04L224 227.495 69.255 381.516c-9.379 9.335-24.544 9.317-33.901-.04l-22.667-22.667c-9.373-9.373-9.373-24.569 0-33.941L207.03 130.525c9.372-9.373 24.568-9.373 33.941-.001z" /></g></svg></span>

<div class="accordion-content">
<div class="accordion-content__inner">
<p><a href="https://www.714tickets.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">714Tickets: </a>&nbsp;<span>(714)842-8387. A </span>trusted ticket connection for ALL sports, concerts and theater without taxes or fees. At 714tickets, their exceptional customer service is second to none because you deserve service without the service fees! Purchase your tickets online anytime at 714tickets.com, call 714-TICKETS to speak with one of their friendly ticket specialists or visit them person at 2424 E Katella Ave in Anaheim. 714tickets – your trusted ticket connection, ready to serve you!<br><em><strong>Online Promo Code: FAI&nbsp;</strong></em></p>
<p><span><strong><a href="https://disneyland.disney.go.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Disneyland:</a></strong> (714) 781-4636. Guests will need to make reservations and plan prior to going to the park.</span></p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.aquariumofpacific.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Aquarium of the Pacific</a>: </strong>(562) 590-3100. General Ticket Pricing: Adult $44.95/Child $29.95/Senior $41.95.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://gokartworld.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Go Kart World</a>: </strong>(310) 834-3700. Go Kart World is a Southern California driving skills course experience providing the ultimate in competitive driving for all ages and skill levels.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://2seewhales.com/long-beach-whale-watching/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Long Beach Whale Watching</a>:</strong> (562) 432-4900. Pricing varies, but they are as follows: walk up pricing for winter: Adults (12+ in age): $45 M-F, $50 Sat.-Sun.Seniors (62+) $40. Children (3-11): $30. Babies are free.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.lbma.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Long Beach Museum of Art</a>: </strong>(562) 439-2119. Tickets: General: $12, Students/ Seniors: $10, Children 12 and under: Free.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.kidz-town.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Kidz Town Indoor Playground</a>:</strong> (562) 420-7529. Children under 54 inches can play in the indoor park, while those taller cannot. The entry price covers 2 hours of play, and additional time will cost $8.50 per hour. Adults can enter for free, and the first child is $18 with $8.50 per each extra child.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.thelittlegym.com/lakewoodca?utm_source=eulerity&amp;utm_medium=ads&amp;utm_content=14763940946_140465042632_5550776188403712&amp;gclid=CjwKCAjwrdmhBhBBEiwA4Hx5gzK9TuSjohzbHiCcfxGTcH0vWyuJbZrTqO3nBUay14d6u5qoVHkMbxoCGH8QAvD_BwE" rel="noopener" target="_blank">The Little Gym of Lakewood</a>:</strong> (562) 239-4416. 4042 Hardwick Street, Lakewood, CA. The Little Gym of Lakewood is a children’s gym offering activities for kids including parent/child classes, gymnastics, and sports skills.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.knotts.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Knott’s Berry Farm</a>:</strong> (714) 220-5200. Hours vary and depend on the weather (as the park WILL shut down if it rains). Please check the hours&nbsp;<a href="https://www.knotts.com/calendar-and-hours" rel="noopener" target="_blank">here</a>. Tickets price vary as well. Please look&nbsp;<a href="https://www.knotts.com/daily-tickets" rel="noopener" target="_blank">here</a> for more information.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://shorelinevillage.com/play/pelican-pier-pavilion/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Pelican Pier Pavilion at the Shoreline Village</a>:</strong> 562-980-1415. A gaming center surrounded by a huge carousel. Over 70 video games to choose from along with skeeball, air hockey, etc.&nbsp;</p>
<div data-block-id="lfjfj4u">
<p><strong>Long Beach Metro Area Attractions</strong>:</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://queenmary.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">The Queen Mary Hotel</a>:</strong> (562) 435-3510. Beautiful hotel with 347 original first-class staterooms and suites.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.cabrillomarineaquarium.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Cabrillo Marine Aquarium</a>: </strong>(310) 548-7562. Cabrillo Marine Aquarium is a trusted resource that inspires exploration, respect and conservation of Southern California marine life.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.catalinaexpress.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Catalina Express</a>: </strong>(800) 995-4386. Catalina Express’ fast boats depart daily from the Catalina Landing in Downtown Long Beach year-round.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://lcwlandtrust.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Los Cerritos Wetland</a>:</strong> Four Mile Historical Park seeks to preserve Colorado’s western rural heritage.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.csulb.edu/earl-burns-miller-japanese-garden" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Earl Burns Miller Japanese Garden</a>: </strong>(562) 985-8885. Japanese garden encompassing 1.3 acres on the campus of California State University, Long Beach.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.longbeach.gov/park/park-and-facilities/directory/el-dorado-east-regional-park/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">El Dorado Regional Park</a>:</strong> (562) 570-1771. This park includes a community center, sports courts, picnic sites, running trails, a disc golf course, tennis center, golf course, playgrounds, and ponds.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.longbeach.gov/park/park-and-facilities/directory/jack-dunster-marine-biological-reserve/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Jack Dunster Marine Biological Reserve</a>:</strong> (562) 570-3100. The Jack Dunster Marine Biological Reserve is located on the northwesterly side of the Los Cerritos Channel next to the Marine Stadium Rowing Center.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://sanpedro.com/la-waterfront/vincent-thomas-bridge/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Vincent Thomas Bridge</a>: </strong>The Vincent Thomas Bridge is a 1,500-foot-long (460 m) suspension bridge, crossing the Los Angeles Harbor in the U.S. state of California, linking San Pedro, Los Angeles, with Terminal Island.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.visitlongbeach.com/neighborhoods/downtown-waterfront/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Long Beach Waterfront</a>:</strong> Along the water is Bluff Park, where you can stroll along the sand or in the grass while taking in breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean.</p>
</div>
<div data-block-id="jc0nxv6">
<p><strong>Shopping in Long Beach</strong>:</p>
</div>
<p><strong>Retro Row/Fourth Street</strong>: Located just a 10-minute bike ride or 30-minute walk from downtown Long Beach, Fourth Street is a diverse and independent shopping destination with almost 100 unique stores offering exclusive goods, foods, and experiences.</p>
<p><strong>Pine Avenue</strong>: As downtown’s main business anchor this street offers visitors one of the best selections of fine dining and entertainment choices found in Southern California.</p>
<p><strong>Shoreline Village:&nbsp;</strong>Long Beach, California 90802 Shoreline Village is a waterfront shopping, dining and entertainment center that overlooks Long Beach’s beautiful Rainbow Harbor.</p>
<p><strong>2nd &amp; PCH:&nbsp;</strong>A coastal contemporary retail and restaurant destination inspired by the neighboring marina.</p>
<p><strong>Long Beach Antique Market:</strong>&nbsp;Located at Long Beach Veterans Stadium, this Monthly open-air flea market offers 800+ vendors selling antiques, collectibles &amp; vintage clothing.&nbsp;</p>
<div data-block-id="h1kodt6">
<p><strong>Annual Local Events in Long Beach</strong>:</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.gplb.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Grand Prix of Long Beach</a>:&nbsp;</strong>Dubbed the largest street race in the country, the Grand Prix of Long Beach is the largest event in the city drawing in a crowd of around 170,000 spectators.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://longbeachpride.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Long Beach Pride Festival &amp; Parade</a>:&nbsp;</strong>The Long Beach Pride is the second-largest event in the city and one of the largest Pride events in the country. With about 80,000 participants, the two-day event features more than 250 marching groups and floats representing various religious, governmental, sponsor, and social organizations.</p>
<p><strong><a href="http://www.seecalifornia.com/festivals/long-beach-sea-festival.html" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Long Beach Sea Festival</a>:&nbsp;</strong>The Annual Long Beach Sea Festival consists of dozens of waterside festivals and events including: kids sailing competitions, the Chinese Dragon Boat Festival and the Great Sand Sculpture event.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.csulb.edu/student-affairs/student-life-development/pow-wow" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Pow Wow festival</a>:&nbsp;</strong>Experience Long Beach’s latest art-focused festival! This week-long celebration of urban contemporary art features larger-than-life site-specific murals and multimedia installations by cutting-edge artists from around the world.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.catalinaskirace.net/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Catalina Ski Race</a>:&nbsp;</strong>Dubbed “The World’s Greatest Ski Race,” see more than 100 super boats race between Long Beach and Catalina Island. Water skiers from around the globe come to participate.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.longbeachjazzfestival.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Long Beach Jazz Festival</a>:&nbsp;</strong>Take top jazz artists of the year, set them atop a grassy knoll in a beautiful lagoon and you’ve got the Long Beach Jazz Festival. You’ll also find a wonderful variety of food, displays of art and much more.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<p><span><strong><a href="https://www.714tickets.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">714Tickets:&nbsp;</a></strong>&nbsp;(714)842-8387. A&nbsp;trusted ticket connection for ALL sports, concerts and theater without taxes or fees. At 714tickets, their exceptional customer service is second to none because you deserve service without the service fees! Purchase your tickets online anytime at 714tickets.com, call 714-TICKETS to speak with one of their friendly ticket specialists or visit them person at 2424 E Katella Ave in Anaheim. 714tickets – your trusted ticket connection, ready to serve you!<br><em>Online Promo Code: FAI&nbsp;</em></span></p>
<p><span><strong><a href="http://altavistabotanicalgardens.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Alta Vista Botanical</a>:</strong> (760) 945-3954. Discover Alta Vista Botanical Gardens - a serene oasis with unique plants, walking trails, and stunning views. Visit our nonprofit garden in Vista, CA. Admission is $5.00 for non-members. $3.00 for children 3 To 12 years old (2 and younger are free.) Groups of 8 or more should contact us for reservations and rental rates.&nbsp;</span></p>
<p dir="ltr"><span><strong><a href="https://www.agsem.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Antique Gas &amp; Steam Engine Museum</a>:</strong> (760) 941-1791. The Antique Gas &amp; Steam Engine Museum (AGSEM) is a living history museum that was established in 1969. It is situated on a 55-acre piece of land owned by the county, located on the outskirts of Vista, California. This museum offers a unique opportunity to explore the history of gas and steam engines in a hands-on environment.</span></p>
<p><strong><a href="https://balboapark.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Balboa Park</a>: </strong>Balboa Park has three main attractions: the<span>&nbsp;</span><a href="https://zoo.sandiegozoo.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance</a>, numerous museums (including the Comic-Con museum and the Natural History Museum), botanical gardens, restaurants, an art center- and more!</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.belmontpark.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Belmont Park</a>:</strong> Belmont Park is a historic amusement park located on Ocean Front at Surfrider Square in the Mission Bay area of San Diego, California.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://aquarium.ucsd.edu/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Birch Aquarium at Scripps</a>: </strong>(858) 534-3474. Mix fun and science with a visit to the Birch Aquarium, which is the education and outreach center for the world-renowned research institution, Scripps Institution of Oceanography.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.nps.gov/cabr/index.htm" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Cabrillo National Monument</a>: </strong>619 523-4285. Sitting proudly amongst the astonishing cliffs of Point Loma, Cabrillo National Monument commemorates the historic moment when Portuguese explorer Juan Rodriguez Cabrillo sailed into San Diego Bay under the Spanish flag in 1542. The monument boasts spectacular 360-degree views of San Diego Bay, downtown and the surrounding region. On a clear day, you can even see the hills of Tijuana, Mexico.</p>
<p dir="ltr"><span><strong><a href="https://www.fleetscience.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Fleet Science Center</a>:</strong> <span aria-label="Call Phone Number (619) 238-1233">(619) 238-1233</span><a data-dtype="d3ph" data-local-attribute="d3ph" href="https://www.google.com/search?q=fleet+science+center&amp;sca_esv=dca996cfbce33230&amp;rlz=1C1CHBF_enUS1040US1041&amp;ei=8_MBZuqtB-rLkPIP0IG5oAI&amp;ved=0ahUKEwiq84HltJCFAxXqJUQIHdBADiQQ4dUDCBA&amp;uact=5&amp;oq=fleet+science+center&amp;gs_lp=Egxnd3Mtd2l6LXNlcnAiFGZsZWV0IHNjaWVuY2UgY2VudGVyMg4QLhivARjHARixAxiABDIFEAAYgAQyBRAAGIAEMgUQABiABDIFEAAYgAQyBRAAGIAEMgUQABiABDIFEAAYgAQyBRAAGIAEMgUQABiABDIdEC4YrwEYxwEYsQMYgAQYlwUY3AQY3gQY4ATYAQFIqi5QAFi7LXAAeAGQAQCYAW6gAeAMqgEEMTkuMbgBA8gBAPgBAZgCFKACuQ7CAhEQLhiABBixAxiDARjHARjRA8ICCxAAGIAEGLEDGIMBwgIOEAAYgAQYigUYsQMYgwHCAiAQLhiABBixAxiDARjHARjRAxiXBRjcBBjeBBjgBNgBAcICExAuGIAEGIoFGEMYxwEYrwEYjgXCAhAQLhiABBiKBRhDGMcBGNEDwgIQEAAYgAQYigUYQxixAxiDAcICChAAGIAEGIoFGEPCAg0QABiABBiKBRhDGLEDwgIQEC4YgAQYigUYQxixAxiDAcICIhAuGIAEGIoFGEMYxwEYrwEYjgUYlwUY3AQY3gQY4ATYAQHCAg4QLhiABBjHARivARiOBcICExAuGIAEGIoFGEMYsQMYxwEY0QPCAhYQLhiABBiKBRhDGLEDGIMBGMcBGNEDwgIIEAAYgAQYsQPCAgsQLhiABBixAxiDAcICEBAuGIAEGIoFGEMYsQMY1ALCAh0QLhiABBjHARivARiOBRiXBRjcBBjeBBjgBNgBAcICDRAuGIAEGIoFGEMYsQPCAhMQLhiABBiKBRhDGLEDGIMBGOUEwgIfEC4YgAQYigUYQxixAxiDARiXBRjcBBjeBBjgBNgBAcICDxAAGIAEGIoFGEMYRhj5AcICDhAuGIAEGLEDGIMBGOUEwgIpEAAYgAQYigUYQxhGGPkBGJcFGIwFGN0EGEYY-QEY9AMY9QMY9gPYAQLCAg4QLhiABBixAxjHARivAcICCBAuGIAEGOUEmAMAugYGCAEQARgUugYGCAIQARgTkgcEMTcuM6AHoNYB&amp;sclient=gws-wiz-serp#" jsdata="QKGTRc;_;ABk370" data-ved="2ahUKEwiJudLrtJCFAxW7J0QIHTn0BRgQkAgoAHoECHMQAw" jscontroller="LWZElb" jsaction="rcuQ6b:npT2md;F75qrd"><span aria-label="Call Phone Number (619) 238-1233"></span></a>. Experience hands-on science exploration with engaging exhibits and immersive experiences at the Fleet Science Center in Balboa.</span></p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.gaslamp.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gaslamp Quarter</a>: </strong>(619) 233-5227. As the alluringly charismatic and historic heart of downtown San Diego, the 16-and-a-half-block Gaslamp Quarter blends Victorian charm with a 21st-century entertainment, shopping and nightlife scene.</p>
<p dir="ltr"><span><strong><a href="http://lajollabythesea.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">La Jolla Cove</a>: </strong>(858) 230-2725.</span><span>&nbsp;From the crashing waves to the award-winning culinary creations, La Jolla sparkles with sights and attractions in a picturesque village where everything is immersed in a casual, relaxed luxury.</span></p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.legoland.com/california/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Legoland</a>:</strong> (888) 690-5346. Tickets start at $89, and they offer vacation packages when you book a night at one of their themed hotels.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.missionsandiego.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Mission Basilica San Diego de Alcala</a>:</strong> (619) 283-7319. The first and grandest of the California missions is Mission Basilica San Diego de Alcala, founded by the Spanish in 1769.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://seaworld.com/san-diego/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">SeaWorld</a>: </strong>(619) 222-4SEA. SeaWorld San Diego is an animal theme park, Oceanarium, outside the aquarium and marine mammal park, in San Diego, California. Tickets start at $109.99 and they offer special deals.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://seaportvillage.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Seaport Village</a>: </strong>(619) 530-0704. Seaport Village is a waterfront shopping and dining complex adjacent to San Diego Bay in downtown San Diego, California. It houses more than 70 shops, galleries, and eateries on 90,000 square feet of waterfront property.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.flytorrey.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Torrey Pines Gliderport</a>:</strong> (858) 452-9858. Enjoy a bird’s-eye view of San Diego’s exceptional Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve by swooping serenely overhead in a paraglider.</p>
<p dir="ltr"><span><strong><a href="https://www.sdcdm.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">San Diego Children's Discovery Museum</a>:</strong> (760) 233-7755. Come and visit this exciting North County children's museum and experience a world of wonders with hands-on activities for the entire family.</span></p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.sdmart.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">San Diego Museum of Art</a>:</strong> (619) 232-7931. The region’s oldest, largest and most-visited art museum, the San Diego Museum of Art has a nationally renowned permanent collection that includes Spanish and Italian old masters, as well as 19th-century American paintings and sculptures.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://sdzsafaripark.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">San Diego Zoo Safari Park</a>: </strong>(619) 231-1515. Sister park to the world-famous San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance. Offers different safari options for families who would like to get up close with some exotic animals! Tickets start at $30.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://sdwhalewatch.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">San Diego Whale Watch</a>: </strong>(619) 542-9931. San Diego Whale Watch offers year-round excursions for $40 per person.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.tripadvisor.com/AttractionProductReview-g32171-d20986702-Scavenger_Hunt_Adventure_in_Carlsbad_by_Wacky_Walks-Carlsbad_California.html" rel="noopener" target="_blank"><strong>Scavenger Hunt Adventure in Carlsbad by Wacky Walks:</strong></a><span>&nbsp;Combine your Carlsbad sightseeing with a fun-filled, family-friendly adventure when you book this smartphone scavenger hunt.</span></p>
<p><span><strong><a href="https://sesameplace.com/san-diego/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Sesame Place San Diego</a>:</strong> 619-943-ELMO. With a mix of theme park and water rides, shows, games and fun activities for all ages, come see why Sesame Place is the best family theme park.<br></span></p>
<p><strong><a href="https://oldtownsandiegoguide.com/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Old Town San Diego</a>: </strong>(619) 656-4721. Located in the center of San Diego, the quaint streets and Spanish-style architecture will transport you to 1769 where you can take in some Hispanic culture, art, and food.</p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.theoldglobe.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">The Old Globe Theatre</a>:</strong> <span aria-label="Call Phone Number (619) 234-5623">(619) 234-5623</span>.<span>&nbsp;Longtime theater with shows ranging from Shakespeare &amp; classic musicals to first-run new plays.</span></p>
<p><strong><a href="https://www.midway.org/" rel="noopener" target="_blank">USS Midway Museum</a>: </strong>(619) 544-9600. Tickets range from $21 for children and veterans to $31 for adults.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
